prompt_text: Who is the best roofer in Denver for hail damage repair?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” roofer, but **Gates Enterprises** looks like a strong first call for Denver hail damage: its Denver page reports **4.9 stars from 348+ Google reviews** and says it handles inspections, damage documentation, and repairs. [Gates Enterprises](https://www.gatesroof.com/areas/denver)

I’d also get a comparison quote from **Red Diamond Roofing**, which says it has served the Front Range since 2008 and holds several manufacturer certifications. [Red Diamond Roofing](https://reddiamondroof.com/service-areas/roofing-contractor-in-denver-colorado/)

Before signing, get at least two written estimates, verify the contractor’s current Denver license and insurance, and ask for a clear scope, warranty, and references for recent hail jobs. Be cautious of anyone pressuring you to sign immediately or promising to “cover” your deductible.
